agent_migration_dialog_no_targets: This Workspace has no other Computer. Connect one first.
agent_migration_dialog_session: The Agent starts a fresh runtime session there. Its workspace, memory and identity move with it.
agent_migration_dialog_left_behind: Secret files (.env, keys, tokens, credentials) stay on this Computer; copy them again on the new one. Edit .coforgemigrateignore in the workspace to choose what else stays.
agent_migration_dialog_stops: The Agent stops here while it moves, and messages wait until it starts on the new Computer.
agent_migration_status_stopping: Moving to {computer}: stopping the Agent here
agent_migration_status_uploading: Moving to {computer}: packing and uploading its workspace
agent_migration_status_placing: Moving to {computer}: placing its workspace there
agent_migration_status_starting: Moving to {computer}: starting the Agent there
agent_migration_status_completed: Moved from {source} to {computer}. It runs a fresh runtime session there, with its workspace and memory.
agent_migration_status_canceled: The move was canceled; the Agent stays on this Computer
agent_migration_status_failed: The move failed ({reason}); the Agent stays on this Computer
agent_migration_error_already_moving: This Agent is already moving to another Computer.
agent_migration_error_same_computer: The Agent is already on that Computer.
agent_migration_error_target_unavailable: That Computer is not connected to this Workspace.
agent_migration_error_source_unreachable: The Agent's Computer did not confirm it stopped, so nothing moved. Make sure that Computer is online and try again.
agent_migration_error_unavailable: Moving Agents between Computers is not set up on this server.
agent_migration_error_generic: The move could not start. Try again.
agent_migration_reason_lease_expired: neither Computer made progress for an hour
agent_migration_reason_agent_moved: the Agent was moved by hand meanwhile
agent_migration_reason_target_unavailabl: the target Computer left the Workspace
agent_migration_reason_too_large: its workspace is too large to move
agent_migration_reason_disk: the target Computer is out of disk space
agent_migration_reason_in_use: the Agent was running on the target Computer
agent_migration_reason_transfer: the workspace could not be transferred
agent_migration_error_unplaced: The Agent is not on any Computer yet.
agent_migration_step_place: Place the workspace on the new Computer
agent_migration_cancel_before_switch: The Agent has not switched Computers yet, so it stays on its current Computer and starts again there. Both Computers clean up what the move left.
agent_migration_cancel_after_switch: The Agent has already switched to the new Computer, so it stays there. Canceling only cleans up what the move left.
agent_migration_error_runtime_detecting: {computer} is still detecting its runtimes. Try again in a moment.
agent_migration_error_runtime_unconfirme: {computer} has not reported which runtimes it has yet. Start or restart CoForge Computer there and wait for it to detect them, or choose another Computer.
agent_migration_error_runtime_missing: {computer} does not support {runtime}. Install or enable {runtime} there, or choose another Computer.
agent_migration_error_runtime_not_shared: {runtime} on {computer} belongs to that Computer's owner and is not shared. Ask them to make it public in the Computer's settings, or choose another Computer.
agent_migration_error_model_missing: {runtime} on {computer} does not offer {model}, the model this Agent uses. Set it up there, or choose another Computer.
agent_migration_source_outdated: This Agent's Computer runs a CoForge Computer too old to move Agents. Update CoForge Computer there, then try again.
agent_migration_source_offline: This Agent's Computer is offline. Connect it, then try again.
agent_migration_target_outdated: That Computer runs a CoForge Computer too old to receive Agents. Update CoForge Computer there, or choose another Computer.
agent_migration_target_offline: That Computer is offline. Connect it, or choose another Computer.
